name: @payswap/onchain-threat-intel
description: Adversarial onchain security + threat intelligence (Work Order P4-W3-003): the adversarial transaction agent and the 13-family onchain threat model (malicious approvals/permits, unexpected spenders, token impersonation, honeypot restrictions, proxy/admin changes, oracle manipulation, bridge compromise, MEV/sandwich exposure, destination/chain confusion, replay/signature-domain issues, unexpected balance/state deltas, stale/changed simulations, finality/reorg anomalies) — every signal carries a mandatory evidence chain and an integer-bps calibrated confidence; the deterministic threat policy stays authoritative (ALLOW | ALLOW_WITH_CONSTRAINTS | REQUIRE_CONFIRMATION | BLOCK) and the agent can NEVER downgrade a BLOCK (kernel law security_agent_cannot_override_block); quarantine/restrict/retire flow through advisory proposals + signature packs that integrate with the existing immune-system machinery
